title: Welcome to the Nightcap Wiki
summary: Your field guide to a different kind of Classic adventure.
body:
A familiar world. Your own path.

Three classes.
One more adventure.

Find your build, learn the custom systems, and discover what is waiting beyond the tunnel.

Start your journey →

New in Nightcap

Raid or Grind in seven private dungeons. Complete personal boss checklists for new rewards, with exclusive Raid drops. Available for live testing.

Build, craft and upgrade. Early spell scribing, stacked tradeskills and Craft All, reusable item upgrades, and equipment for your held classes are live.

Passive AA is now 20% alongside normal leveling. Read the latest changes →

At the campfire

  • Keep the command reference handy
  • Update your launcher and game
  • Read about combat and recovery
  • See what is still in development

Nightcap is in live testing. Feature labels distinguish installed systems from unreleased work.
